title: Employability
description: Great career prospects ahead! Discover what happens after the Master of Science in Oncology and the opportunies that are waiting for you.

blocks.html:
Graduates of MOTIA will be well prepared for careers in:

  • Basic and translational biomedical research
  • Biotechnology and pharmaceutical industries
  • Clinical trial management
  • Computational and data-driven biomedical sciences
  • Science communication, technology transfer, and entrepreneurship

The Master of Science in Oncology, Translational Immunology and Aging also provides a solid foundation for graduates to pursue a PhD programme.
